correction_reason: The September 22 assessment incorrectly treated the $1,500-per-month UCC bulk-download service as a corporate business-entity product. The official corporate offering evidenced here is the one-time Database Records Access Request; UCC pricing is not corporate-registry pricing.

access.bulk: The official Database Records Access Request offers one-time active-entity lists by email or CD: $200 for all for-profit corporations, LLCs, LPs and LLPs, or $150 for specified entity classes. Entire-database requests are routed to Information Network of Kansas (INK), with contract, price and delivery terms unknown.
access.api: No official business-entity read API or unattended delivery contract was established.
access.search: Official entity search exists separately and is not evidence of bulk automation permission.

fields.summary: The request form identifies Business Entity ID, entity type and status, name, mailing address, formation date and jurisdiction, resident-agent name, and registered-office address. Person and registered-agent fields require exclusion; no machine-readable schema, sample or checksum is published.

active_status_semantics: The offered lists are described as active entities, but registry status and biennial-report standing are legal filing evidence rather than verified current operation; a complete status codebook is not published.
statewide_completeness: The $150-$200 products are bounded one-time active-entity lists. An entire-database route exists through INK, but its population, exclusions, contract, price and delivery terms are unknown.
address_zip: Mailing and registered-office addresses are listed. Mailing address is administrative evidence only; registered-office and resident-agent data must be excluded. No principal or physical-site field is established.
automation_terms_fees: One-time active lists cost $150 or $200 and may be supplied by email or CD. Entire-database inquiries go to INK. No recurring corporate feed, automated retrieval permission, or corporate $1,500 monthly price is established.
redistribution: The request form does not grant retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication or redistribution rights, and K.S.A. 45-230 restricts use of public name/address lists for sales solicitation.
temporal_refresh: The evidenced corporate products are one-time lists; no recurring cadence, full/delta semantics, deletions, replay, archive, counts or checksums are documented. Kansas biennial reporting can make legal/address evidence approximately two years old.

citations.evidence: Official Database Records Access Request describing one-time active-entity products, fields, $150-$200 pricing, email/CD delivery, and routing of entire-database inquiries to INK.
Official KSUCC cost list; establishes that the frequently cited bulk subscription belongs to UCC services, not corporate business-entity data.
Official Kansas statute restricting use of public-record names and addresses for sales solicitation.
Official business-entity search route, not evidence of a complete automated bulk feed.

strongest_next_action: Request non-row-bearing written SOS/INK terms for the entire corporate database, including price, population, person-free schema, Business Entity ID lifecycle, status and address dictionaries, cadence, full/delta/deletion/replay/checksum behavior, unattended delivery, and retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication and redistribution rights.
